item.title: Homes evacuated overnight due to ongoing security alert in Derry - Highland Radio - Latest Donegal News and Sport
item.description: A number of families have been evacuated from their homes in Derry overnight. The PSNI says a security alert is continuing in the Glenabbey Close area of the city. Cordons are in place and residents have been told they can’t return home yet.
